animations.name: wird_done_shimmer
animations.beats: v4. Anticipation squash 10% 0-0.15 s; hop to 12% with 10% stretch 0.15-0.40 s, leaves flick down then up; happy-arc eyes and open smile 0.30-0.75 s; landing squash 14% 0.40-0.55 s, two damped wobbles to 0.90 s; light band sweeps feet to tip 0.45-1.05 s, following the curve of the drop, feathered over >=40% of its height each side, hue 46-50, half strength across the face; eyes reopen at 0.75 s; one slow blink at 1.15 s. animations.name: milestone_glow
animations.beats: v4. Anticipation squash 18% 0-0.35 s while the inner light starts to rise; take-off 0.35 s; jump to 35% with 18% stretch and one full spin 0.35-0.85 s; at the top, frontal, the cheer with happy-arc eyes, open smile and lifted brows 0.85-1.10 s; fall and landing squash 18% 1.10-1.30 s; light peak 1.30-1.40 s (risen over >=0.4 s, hue 44-48) with a burst of 6-8 sparkles from the upper body fading within 0.7 s, cores 4-5 px at S; dark render halo blooms with the peak, light render no outer halo and sparkles with a thin deeper-gold edge; two damped wobbles as the arms lower 1.40-2.10 s; eyes reopen at 2.10 s; one slow blink at 2.50 s after the light starts to fall.

animations.name: juz_light

budget_bytes.counts: every runtime export incl. variants, posters and the A01 still; masters and review exports excluded; decimal bytes
budget_bytes.note_v4: raised from 3,500,000 / 150,000 / 300,000 because jumps, spins and sparkle bursts compress worse; the v3.1 set was 1,218,780 bytes

sampling: nominal samples = round(seconds x 24); first and last samples exactly on start and hold poses; integer ms frame durations summing to the declared length; identical samples may merge
global_render_rules: rest centre near value 88; flanks value >=80 and saturation >=88; darkest gold only in the last 4-6% of the silhouette; no inner contour line
arms blend into the body at the shoulder with a soft highlight; feet chunky and rounded with height, no inner ring; key highlight soft at its lower end; warm caustic
no contact shadow in any file, including the light glow variants
hold frames: every pixel outside the silhouette exactly transparent
closed eyes in a calm line never coincide with the light peak, rising motes or a seated pose; happy-arc eyes with the open smile on a moving body are allowed at the peak
happy-arc eyes and the open smile only in celebrations, only while the body moves, never on a hold, poster or seated pose; the mouth closes to the warm smile before the hold
the open smile has a dark warm interior, no teeth and no tongue
the cheer: arms out and up at 30-50 deg above horizontal, tips well outside the body width and below the top of the body, never in front of the body or beside the face, at most 0.5 s
start, hold and poster frames are frontal; only spin frames pass through side views; the face overlay turns with the body and hides past the side
light leaves the body only as separate sparkles or motes that fade by opacity; no ring, disc, rays or crown
no fire, confetti, fireworks, explosions, trophies or points

celebration.easing: anticipation, then ease out with a small overshoot

big_celebration.spin: one full turn about the vertical axis
big_celebration.easing: anticipation, then ease out with a small overshoot

comfort.easing: slow-in and slow-out, sine or cubic

registers.note: Heights are fractions of the body height without the twig. Every jump lands where it took off. A19's drop-in is outside these limits.
